theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 31 群

items.colloc: form a line 排隊 | wait in a line 在隊伍中等待
items.distinct: stand in line 美式用法 | queue up 英式用法
ex: Please stand in a line at the counter.
請在櫃台前排成一列。
The customers stand in a line for coffee.
顧客們排成一列等咖啡。
Workers must stand in a line for inspection.
員工必須排成一列接受檢查。

items.colloc: stand in line for hours 排隊數小時 | stand in line to enter 排隊進場
items.distinct: stand in a line 排成隊形 | line up 排隊
ex: I had to stand in line for twenty minutes.
我不得不排隊二十分鐘。
Employees stand in line to register at events.
員工排隊在活動現場簽到。
Do not stand in line near the emergency exit.
不要在緊急出口附近排隊。

items.pos: phr. 堅持立場；站在…之上
items.colloc: stand on one's principle 堅持原則 | stand on firm ground 立場穩固
items.distinct: stand for 代表 | stand by 支持
ex: The manager decided to stand on the agreement.
經理決定堅持該協議的內容。
You must stand on your own two feet.
你必須學會獨立自主。
The decision to stand on the policy is final.
堅持該政策的決定已成定局。

items.zh: 延長營業時間；營業至深夜
items.colloc: stay open late for customers 為顧客延長營業 | stay open late during holidays 節慶延後打烊
items.distinct: open late 較晚開門 | close late 晚打烊
ex: The department store will stay open late tonight.
百貨公司今晚會營業至深夜。
We stay open late during the busy season.
我們在旺季期間會延長營業時間。
Retail shops often stay open late on weekends.
零售店週末通常會營業至深夜。

items.colloc: step down as CEO 辭去執行長職務 | step down from the position 卸下職位
items.distinct: resign 辭職 | retire 退休
ex: The president will step down next month.
總裁下個月將會辭職。
He decided to step down due to health.
他因健康因素決定卸下職務。
It is time for the director to step down.
現在是該董事卸任的時候了。

items.colloc: notice a striking difference 注意到顯著差異 | highlight a striking difference 強調明顯差異
items.distinct: obvious difference 明顯差異 | slight difference 微小差異
ex: There is a striking difference in productivity.
生產力方面有顯著的差異。
We observed a striking difference between these models.
我們觀察到這些型號間有明顯差異。
The report shows a striking difference in costs.
報告顯示成本上有顯著差異。

items.colloc: learn to take a fact 學會接受事實 | hard to take a fact 難以接受現實
items.distinct: accept the fact 接受事實 | ignore the fact 忽略事實
ex: It is hard to take a fact sometimes.
有時真的很難接受事實。
You must take a fact and move forward.
你必須接受事實並向前邁進。
Management needs to take a fact about losses.
管理層需要面對虧損的事實。

items.pos: phr. 代為留言；記錄訊息
items.colloc: take a message for someone 為某人記錄訊息 | offer to take a message 主動幫忙留言
items.distinct: leave a message 留下訊息 | send a message 發送訊息
ex: May I take a message for the director?
我可以幫您轉達訊息給董事嗎？
She offered to take a message for him.
她主動提出幫他記錄口信。
I will take a message if he returns.
如果他回來我會幫忙留言。

items.colloc: take a walk during break 休息時間散步 | take a walk in the park 到公園散步
items.distinct: go for a walk 去散步 | walk the dog 遛狗
ex: Let us take a walk during our lunch break.
我們午休時間去散個步吧。
He decided to take a walk to relax.
他決定散步以放鬆身心。
Staff often take a walk in the garden.
員工常在花園裡散步。

items.colloc: take immediate action 立即採取行動 | take legal action 採取法律行動
items.distinct: make a move 開始行動 | carry out 執行
ex: We must take action to improve sales.
我們必須採取行動來提升銷售額。
The company decided to take action against leaks.
公司決定對洩密採取行動。
Failure to take action will result in losses.
不採取行動將會導致損失。

items.pos: phr. 感到非常高興；引以為樂
items.colloc: take great pleasure in doing sth. 樂於做某事 | take great pleasure in helping 以助人為樂
items.distinct: be pleased to 很高興能 | feel honored 感到榮幸
ex: I take great pleasure in welcoming our guest.
我非常榮幸能歡迎我們的貴賓。
They take great pleasure in completing the task.
他們很樂於完成這項任務。
She takes great pleasure in mentoring new staff.
她很樂於指導新進員工。

items.zh: 採取主動；發揮首創精神
items.colloc: take the initiative 主動出擊 | show initiative 展現積極主動
items.distinct: be proactive 主動的 | be passive 被動的
ex: Employees should take initiative to solve problems.
員工應主動去解決問題。
He took initiative to organize the seminar.
他主動發起籌辦了這次研討會。
Taking initiative is vital for your career.
採取主動對你的職業生涯至關重要。

items.colloc: take note of the details 注意細節 | take note during the meeting 開會時做記錄
items.distinct: pay attention 注意 | keep a record 保持記錄
ex: Please take note of the deadline changes.
請留意截止日期的變更。
I will take note of your suggestions.
我會將你的建議記下來。
Make sure to take note of the client's request.
務必留意客戶的要求。

items.colloc: take out insurance on property 為財產投保 | take out insurance on equipment 為設備投保
items.distinct: insure 投保 | purchase a policy 購買保單
ex: We should take out insurance on the cargo.
我們應該為這批貨物投保。
Did you take out insurance on the new machine?
你有為那台新機器投保嗎？
Companies take out insurance on their buildings.
公司通常會為辦公大樓投保。

items.colloc: take the order from a client 接下客戶訂單 | wait to take the order 等待點餐
items.distinct: place an order 下訂單 | cancel an order 取消訂單
ex: The waiter will come to take the order.
服務生稍後會過來點餐。
Our sales representative will take the order now.
我們的業務代表現在會處理這筆訂單。
It takes time to take the order correctly.
正確地接下訂單需要花點時間。

items.colloc: keep it to the point 保持簡明扼要 | be direct and to the point 直截了當
items.distinct: concise 簡潔的 | irrelevant 不相關的
ex: His presentation was clear and to the point.
他的簡報清晰且切中要點。
Try to keep your report to the point.
試著讓你的報告簡明扼要。
She gave a response that was to the point.
她給出的回應切中要點。

items.colloc: obey the traffic signal 遵守交通號誌 | ignore the traffic signal 闖紅燈
items.distinct: traffic light 交通燈 | street sign 路牌
ex: Please stop at the next traffic signal.
請在下一個紅綠燈處停車。
The traffic signal is broken at the intersection.
十字路口的交通號誌壞了。
He turned left after the traffic signal changed.
交通號誌變換後他便左轉。

items.colloc: book via a travel agency 透過旅行社預訂 | work for a travel agency 在旅行社工作
items.distinct: tour operator 旅行營運商 | airline 航空公司
ex: I booked our business trip at a travel agency.
我透過旅行社預訂了我們的商務行程。
The travel agency offers corporate travel packages.
該旅行社提供企業差旅方案。
We consulted a travel agency for visa advice.
我們諮詢了旅行社關於簽證的建議。

items.colloc: complete the trial period 完成試用期 | extend the trial period 延長試用期
items.distinct: probation period 試用期（法規較常用）| pilot project 試驗計畫
ex: All new hires must undergo a trial period.
所有新進員工都必須經過試用期。
Your performance is evaluated during the trial period.
你的表現會在試用期內進行評估。
He passed the trial period with high marks.
他以優異成績通過了試用期。

items.pos: phr. 拒絕；調低（音量/溫度）
items.colloc: turn down an offer 拒絕提議 | turn down the volume 調低音量
items.distinct: reject 拒絕 | decline 婉拒
ex: They had to turn down the job offer.
他們不得不拒絕這份工作邀請。
Please turn down the music in the office.
請將辦公室裡的音樂調小聲。
Management decided to turn down the budget proposal.
管理層決定否決這項預算提案。
